editorial:
Imagine if your worst enemy came back from the dead, but this time he is made of metal. That is exactly what happens here as Cooler returns to wreak havoc on New Namek. You get to see Goku and his friends jump into action to stop this robotic menace before he enslaves everyone. The vibe is pure old-school energy with loud explosions, glowing energy beams, and that classic feeling of the Z-fighters trying to protect the innocent. It feels like a high-stakes arcade game brought to life on screen.

What really pops are the fight scenes, which keep a brisk pace and never let you get bored. While the plot is pretty simple, the action makes up for it. One downside is that some of the side characters do not get much to do, but the final showdown is totally worth it. If you love big battles, you should definitely check this out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick watch, or if you are a true fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the best way to see those colors shine.
endingExplained: The fight ends when Goku realizes that Cooler's metal body has a weak spot. After a huge struggle, Goku hits Cooler with a massive energy blast that destroys the robot for good. With the villain gone, the people of New Namek are finally safe. Goku and his friends head home, knowing they stopped a galactic threat. It is a straightforward win that leaves you feeling satisfied and hyped.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves huge battles and classic anime.
